meta.unit: weekly hard working sets per muscle (warm-up sets never count [T4])
meta.maintained_by: keep in sync with knowledge/02-programming-variables.md and muscle files knowledge/09-13; never add uncited numbers

generic_landmarks.note: retention ~3 and 6-8 minimal growth [T22]; 10-20 default growth [T1, T6]; 20-30 small-muscle claim [T6]; >10-12 diminishing ROI [T22] — knowledge/08 contradiction #4

session_caps.note: stimulus plateaus ~6 hard sets/muscle/session [T4, T22]; ~7 defensible when the muscle spans regions (back/6 pro pull day); contradiction #6 lists T22 ~6 vs T23 15-16
session_caps.per_exercise_note: max ~5 sets per exercise per session; more volume -> add a different-angle exercise [T6]

chest.source: T1, T6 via knowledge/02; chest/1 via knowledge/10
chest.notes: 2 sessions/wk endorsed; a single 25-set chest day rejected [chest/1]

back.notes: count lats + upper back + floor pulls together; >25 working sets/wk = recovery risk for most [back/1]

quads.notes: generic large-muscle band; rectus femoris grows only from leg extensions regardless of total [legs/1, legs/2]

hamstrings.notes: train BOTH functions: knee flexion (curls; seated > lying) + hip extension (hinges) [legs/1]

glutes.source: T1, T6 via 02; legs/1, legs/3 via 11
glutes.notes: heavy indirect coverage from squats/hinges/unilateral work; direct thrusts/abduction optional

calves.notes: contradiction #10: dedicated sets + 30-s stretch holds [legs/1] vs life-load theory, gym work mostly tendon health [legs/3]

side_delts.notes: 12-16 applies when delts are the PRIORITY (spread over 3 days); 6-8 = growth surplus for non-priority [T22]; overhead pressing does not build them [shoulders/5]

rear_delts.source: no explicit range; dispute logged in knowledge/12
rear_delts.notes: contradiction #9: overrated if back training is proper [shoulders/2] vs prioritize-first [shoulders/3,4,6]; strong back volume overlaps heavily

front_delts.notes: mostly covered by chest pressing; direct work only if lagging

biceps.notes: DIRECT sets only; back work counts as indirect; tolerable up to ~10; specialization 9-14 [arms/3]

triceps.notes: DIRECT sets only; pressing covers medial/lateral heads; overhead/stretch isolation covers the long head

traps.notes: direct mid/lower-trap work (Kelso shrugs): start 6/wk, progress toward 12 if recovery allows; upper traps get shrugs + carrying

abs.source: no explicit range in the knowledge files
abs.notes: no per-muscle norm logged; direct work optional (e.g., roman-chair raises [legs/2])
